title: Tell us: have you been misdiagnosed with a medical condition?
text:
Have you been misdiagnosed with a medical condition? Photograph: David Davies/PA
Tell us: have you been misdiagnosed with a medical condition?
We are looking for people to share their stories of misdiagnosis, how they realised this had happened, and perhaps found another diagnosis
Last month the actor Christina Applegate revealed that she had been misdiagnosed with multiple sclerosis. She announced that she had the condition in 2021, and has spoken candidly about her experiences of it, becoming a prominent advocate for people living with MS.
“I’m back at square one ... I don’t know what’s going on with me.” Applegate said on her podcast MeSsy, adding: “There’s a pretty damn high number of misdiagnoses with MS.”
Have you, like Applegate, been misdiagnosed with a medical condition? We are looking for people to share their stories of misdiagnosis, how they realised this had happened, and perhaps found another diagnosis. If you are open to sharing your own experience of this, fill in the form below.
Share your experience
You can share your response using this form.
Please share your story if you are 18 or over, anonymously if you wish. For more information please see our terms of service and privacy policy.
Tell us here
Your responses, which can be anonymous, are secure as the form is encrypted and only the Guardian has access to your contributions. We will only use the data you provide us for the purpose of the feature and we will delete any personal data when we no longer require it for this purpose. For alternative ways to get in touch securely please see our tips guide.
